newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela's Lagoven to up exports 13 pct in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela's Lagoven to up exports 13 pct in 1997.

text.p: State-owned Petroleos de Venezuela (PdVSA) subsidiary Lagoven said it would increase crude exports by some 142,000 barrels per day (bpd), or 13 percent, to 1.19 million bpd by the end of the year.

Nearly half of that increase would come from production at marginal fields rising to 117,000 bpd from 62,000 bpd, the company said in a press release. The marginal fields are co- operated with oil majors such as British Petroleum, Total and Amoco.
Lagoven, the largest of PdVSA's operating companies, added that oil production capacity would rise to 1.425 million bpd in 1997 from 1.330 million bpd at the close of 1996.
Natural gas production would also move ahead 4,000 bpd to reach 52,000 bpd by the end of the year, the company said
